Tonight · before and after

10 commits, none of them deployed. Every image below is a real screenshot of the running app.

The BHBC replan → The full undeployed list →

The BHBC dashboard

Seven cards became four. The next game was printed three times, availability three times, medical four. Four of the seven columns in the main table had never held a value.

  • cards7 → 4
  • height~2,150px → ~1,540px
  • empty columns4 → 0

ACWR, the 7-day figure, the 14-day spark and readiness need an sRPE and a wellness check-in this club does not collect. They come back the moment one session carries an RPE. In their place: LAST LIFT, which is never blank.

The weight room — a tab that did not exist

Your availability sheet is athletes down, days across. The app had no grid at all: it showed today, and one athlete at a time. This is that grid, with the restriction and the workout in the same cell.

  • beforeno such screen
  • gridathletes × days
  • due listlongest gap first

Orange is a logged lift, the tint is the restriction. Days that have not happened are not columns. The physio reads the same board in Hebrew, right to left.

The printed block

Too spacious and not branded enough — all three causes were rules added for the opposite complaint, a short day floating on a blank sheet.

  • Day A~1,400px → ~810px
  • per sheet1.5 days → 2+
  • mastheadwordmark → block

The row is two columns now — what to do on the left, how to do it on the right — so a row is as tall as its cues instead of as tall as the page.
